body_markdown:
***Consolidated Quarterly Organic Net Sales Growth Reaches 14%***


HOLLYWOOD, FL AND MIAMI, FL **** – HEICO Corporation (NYSE:HEI.A, HEI) today reported an increase in net income of 33% to a record $235.4 million, or $1.67 per diluted share, in the third quarter of fiscal 2026, up from $177.3 million, or $1.26 per diluted share, in the third quarter of fiscal 2025. Net income increased 31% to a record $659.4 million, or $4.67 per diluted share, in the first nine months of fiscal 2026, up from $502.1 million, or $3.57 per diluted share, in the first nine months of fiscal 2025.


[Read more](https://www.accessnewswire.com/newsroom/en/aerospace-and-defense/heico-corporation-reports-record-net-income-up-33-on-record-operating-income-1211982)
